code:
use default

let subjects = ["møøse", "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢", "J̲o̲s̲é̲"]

for subject in subjects do
    write_line(
        "{subject}: {subject.enumerate_runes() |> count()} code points, "

od
fullSource:
use default

let subjects = ["møøse", "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢", "J̲o̲s̲é̲"]

for subject in subjects do
    write_line(
        "{subject}: {subject.enumerate_runes() |> count()} code points, "
        "{subject.length} UTF-16 code units")
od
output:
møøse: 5 code points, 5 UTF-16 code units
𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢: 7 code points, 14 UTF-16 code units
J̲o̲s̲é̲: 9 code points, 9 UTF-16 code units
